checklists.title: Ghazal Night - Ranjit Rajwada
checklists.subtitle: Mic Drop Events FZE · Dubai · January 2027 · Tripartite structure · Project checklist

setup.label: Show date
setup.note: Fill this in. Every due date on the Checklist tab is driven off this cell.

setup.label: Longstop date for venue + date
setup.note: Clause 3.1 of the term sheet. If unconfirmed by this date, either party can walk.

setup.label: Venue
setup.note: Ramee Dream ballroom is the current candidate. Unconfirmed.

setup.label: Ballroom capacity (your layout)
setup.note: Theatre or cabaret seating, NOT the F&B round-table number the hotel will quote.

setup.label: Artist fee (AED, all-in)
setup.note: INR 200,000 equivalent. Confirm the peg rate with Sifat.

tasks.task: Send the tripartite agreement to Sifat and Ranjit
tasks.why: You draft first, you set the anchor. Send to both, not via Sifat alone.

tasks.task: Get Ranjit's own contact details and deal with him directly
tasks.why: He is a party now. Never let Sifat be the only channel to your artist.

tasks.task: Obtain Annexe A: signed NOC on Sifat letterhead
tasks.why: Irrevocable consent. If they will not sign it, the project stops.

tasks.task: Obtain clause 3.3 disclosure of the Sifat-Ranjit arrangement
tasks.why: Written or oral? What term? Any exclusivity? Due 7 days after signing.

tasks.task: Split the INR 200,000 into Artist Fee and Facilitation Fee
tasks.why: Clause 6.1. Unsplit, you risk paying Ranjit's fee twice.

tasks.task: Confirm the total is INR 200,000 all-in, not Sifat's slice
tasks.why: Get this in writing before anything else in this workstream.

tasks.task: Peg the AED rate and state it in clause 6.1
tasks.why: Fix in AED so FX movement sits with them.

tasks.task: Confirm clause 10.2 protects the dastangoi script
tasks.why: The commissioned story is yours. This clause survives indefinitely.

tasks.task: DIFC-qualified lawyer reviews clauses 2, 3, 7.4 and 11
tasks.why: Consent irrevocability and liquidated damages are where drafting shows.

tasks.task: All three parties execute; store the signed copy
tasks.why: Ranjit signs in his personal capacity, not through Sifat.

tasks.task: Sign the project charter with Sunny
tasks.why: Kill criteria and budget ceiling agreed before money is committed.

tasks.task: Define Sunny's role: sales or operations, not both
tasks.why: Charter section 4. Shared ownership means nobody owns it.

tasks.task: Commission the dastangoi script
tasks.why: Currently unfunded. Writer fee plus performer fee are not in the budget.

tasks.task: Contract the storyteller / dastango
tasks.why: Co-billed, not support. Separate fee, flights and visa if from India.

tasks.task: Schedule the two remote run-throughs with the Narrator
tasks.why: Clause 5.4(a). A scripted show cannot be assembled on the day.

tasks.task: Confirm Ranjit arrives 48 hours out, not 24
tasks.why: Clause 5.5. The dastangoi format needs the extra rehearsal day.

tasks.task: Agree instrumentation with Ranjit in writing
tasks.why: Annexe B. Tabla, harmonium or keys, sarangi or not.

tasks.task: Shortlist Dubai musicians and send for artist approval
tasks.why: Clause 8.2. Silence for 14 days counts as approval. Send it early.

tasks.task: Receive the technical rider and stage plot
tasks.why: Clause 8.4. Anything notified after this is at the Artist's cost.

tasks.task: Book the joint rehearsal (narrator + singer + musicians)
tasks.why: A scripted show cannot be assembled at soundcheck.

tasks.task: Lock the final running order and setlist
tasks.why: Chapter by chapter, so lighting and LED cues can be built.

tasks.task: Ramee: is the AED 30,000 an F&B minimum or a hire fee?
tasks.why: Ask in writing. Changes the entire cost model.

tasks.task: Ramee: is the AV inventory included or charged separately?
tasks.why: The banquet list is a wedding rig. Assume add-ons are extra.

tasks.task: Ramee: can you bring an external AV supplier?
tasks.why: If in-house is mandatory, price every add-on before signing anything.

tasks.task: Get capacity for theatre or cabaret layout
tasks.why: Not the round-table number. Costs you 20 to 30 per cent of seats.

tasks.task: Confirm show date and venue before the longstop
tasks.why: Clause 3.1. Miss it and either party can walk away.

tasks.task: Sign the venue contract and pay the deposit
Confirm load-in, soundcheck and curfew times
tasks.why: Hotels have hard curfews. A 90-minute show plus interval needs headroom.

tasks.task: Walk the room: sightlines, acoustics, pillars
tasks.why: Ballrooms are reverberant. Narration intelligibility is the risk.

tasks.task: Add 4 to 6 monitor wedges on 3 aux mixes
tasks.why: Not on the hotel list. He cannot pitch off a front-facing array.

tasks.task: Add tabla and harmonium mics, DI boxes, stands
tasks.why: Hotel has two handhelds and a podium mic. That is all.

tasks.task: Add warm front wash plus two profile specials
tasks.why: Rig has zero face light. Beams and RGB pars cannot render skin tone.

tasks.task: Swap the analogue MGP32 for a digital desk
tasks.why: Scene recall per chapter and proper monitor sends.

tasks.task: Add spare wireless handhelds or lavs
tasks.why: Two lead voices, currently zero redundancy.

tasks.task: Design LED wall content (7.0m x 2.9m, P2.5)
tasks.why: Static couplets and translation. No video behind a seated singer.

tasks.task: Book two-camera capture and a board feed
tasks.why: Clause 8.3 gives you 3 minutes of promo excerpts. Use it.

tasks.task: Programme lighting cues chapter by chapter
tasks.why: Avolites Tiger Touch can hold a cue stack. Build it in advance.

tasks.task: Confirm no smoke machine; light haze in interval only
tasks.why: Throat risk for two singers, plus banquet smoke detectors.

tasks.task: Collect artist visa documentation from Ranjit
tasks.why: Clause 7.3. Due 60 days out. Late submission is an artist default.

tasks.task: Apply for the artist performance permit
Apply for the DET event permit
tasks.why: Roughly AED 2,000 to 3,000 on your estimate.

tasks.task: Book flights and hotel for one traveller, 3 nights
tasks.why: Clause 7.1. Anyone additional travels at their own cost.

tasks.task: Arrange public liability insurance
tasks.why: Clause 13.1 puts this squarely on you as promoter.

tasks.task: Confirm venue security and crowd management plan
Finish the show economics model
tasks.why: Must now include script commission and Narrator fee. Both unfunded.

tasks.task: Decide the paid marketing budget honestly
tasks.why: AED 3,000 on Meta yields 20 to 30 tickets for an unknown artist.

tasks.task: Approach a title sponsor to cover the venue cost
tasks.why: Highest-value single lever available to you.

tasks.task: Work the community channels
tasks.why: Rajasthani and Marwari associations, Urdu poetry circles, majlis groups.

tasks.task: Corporate and bulk table outreach
tasks.why: Table sales de-risk the fixed cost faster than retail tickets.

tasks.task: List on Platinumlist and go on sale
Lock the artist promo schedule
tasks.why: Clause 9.1. Starts 6 weeks out. AED 1,000 deduction per miss.

tasks.task: Brief press, radio and podcast interviews
tasks.why: Clause 9.1 gives you up to 3 hours of artist time.

tasks.task: Review sales; decide whether to paper the room
tasks.why: A visibly full room matters more than the last 40 tickets of revenue.

tasks.task: Final settlement schedule agreed with Sifat
tasks.why: Clause 4.3. Final 50 per cent is payable on the day, after the show.

tasks.task: Print run sheet, cue sheet and contact list
Artist arrives in Dubai
tasks.why: Clause 5.5. Not later than 48 hours before the show.

tasks.task: Full rehearsal: Narrator, Artist, musicians
tasks.why: Clause 5.4(b). Included in the fee.

tasks.task: Soundcheck, minimum 2 hours
tasks.why: Clause 5.4(c). Do not let the hotel compress this.

tasks.task: Pay the final 50 per cent, split per clause 6.1
tasks.why: After the performance, not before. Two separate transfers.

tasks.task: Reconcile the final P&L against the model
Collect footage and cut the promo reel
tasks.why: Clause 8.3. This is the asset that sells show two.

tasks.task: Decide whether to exercise the option on future shows
tasks.why: Clause 10.7. Sifat waives commission on option shows.

tasks.task: Review the charter kill criteria against actual outcome
tasks.why: Did you continue past a trigger? Record why, for next time.
